Provide a resource to create a kubernetes cluster endpoint. This resource allows you to create an empty cluster first without any workers. Only all attached node depends create complete, cluster endpoint will finally be enabled.

> **NOTE:** Recommend using `dependsOn` to make sure endpoint create after node pools or workers does.

> **NOTE:** Please do not use this resource and resource `tencentcloud.Kubernetes.Cluster` to operate cluster public network/intranet access at the same time.
